o.text: Borrowed from Persian فعالیّت (fa'âliyyat), from Arabic فَعَّالِيَّة (faʕʕāliyya). By surface analysis, fəal + -iyyət
From döy- (“to beat, to beat up”) + -üş. Cognate with Turkish dövüş.
Borrowed from Arabic اِقْتِصَادِيّ (iqtiṣādiyy). By surface analysis, iqtisad + -i.
